findings.title: Hero text colour produces black-on-dark-green — unreadable
findings.location: Design §Feature 3 Hero section — text-neutral-100 on bg-neutral-200
findings.summary: neutral-100=#17211b (near-black) on bg-neutral-200=#2e3a32 (dark green) gives ~1.5:1 contrast. Use text-neutral-950 (#ffffff) for headline and badge text.

findings.title: CTA hover state uses amber-300 which is identical to amber-400 — no visible change
findings.location: Design §Feature 3 Hero section and Closing CTA banner — hover:bg-amber-300
findings.summary: amber-300 and amber-400 both map to #15803d in globals.css. The hover produces no visual feedback. Use hover:bg-amber-500 (#166534) or redefine amber-300 in the theme.

findings.title: getDishes() is async — design treats it as synchronous, landing page will crash without await
findings.location: Design §Feature 3 Architecture decision and §Error Handling Feature 3
findings.summary: getDishes() in src/lib/dishes.js is declared async. The landing page must be an async Server Component and must await getDishes(). The design omits both async and await.

findings.title: og:title format ambiguous between <title> template and openGraph.title explicit field
findings.summary: Design does not distinguish title (uses layout template, dish name only) from openGraph.title (explicitly set with suffix). Risk of implementer double-appending the suffix. Add explicit note: do not modify the title field.

findings.title: Contradictory hero bleed instructions — negative-margin approach mentioned then discarded in same paragraph
findings.summary: Design describes negative-margin bleed then says 'Design choice: contained hero'. Remove all mention of the bleed approach; state the decision once clearly.

findings.title: MobileNav props omit signOut Server Action — no guidance on how client component calls it
findings.location: Design §2a MobileNav.jsx — Props: { session: { name, role } | null }
findings.summary: The sign-out form needs the signOut Server Action. Design must explicitly state whether MobileNav imports it directly or receives it as a prop.

findings.title: getDishCardImage import missing from page.js code sketch for FeaturedDishCard
findings.location: Design §Feature 3 Curated featured dishes and FeaturedDishCard description
findings.summary: The design never shows import { getDishes, getDishCardImage } from '@/lib/dishes' in page.js. Add it explicitly.

findings.title: scrollbar-none must use @utility in Tailwind v4, not a plain CSS class rule
findings.summary: Replace .scrollbar-none { ... } with @utility scrollbar-none { scrollbar-width: none; &::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } } to be a proper Tailwind v4 utility.

findings.title: FilterShell sort/count row not addressed — will overflow at 320 px
findings.summary: The outer flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between row containing the count and sort label is not made flex-col on mobile. Add flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between.

findings.title: Checkout link tap-target already met — design overstates the problem
findings.location: Design §2d CartItems.jsx fix — Proceed to Checkout link
findings.summary: Existing py-3 on the link already satisfies the 44 px tap target. The block w-full change is a UX enhancement, not a required fix. Label it as optional.

findings.title: Design states Next.js version without consulting in-repo docs as required by AGENTS.md
findings.summary: AGENTS.md requires reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code. The design makes no mention of this. Add a note instructing the implementer to check in-repo docs first.

findings.title: FeaturedDishCard inlined in page.js — note intent to prevent future confusion
findings.summary: Inline sub-components in Server Component files are fine, but should have a comment noting extraction is needed if client interactivity is added.

findings.title: animate-[fadeInDown_...] arbitrary syntax token order — should be documented
findings.location: Design §Feature 3 Keyframe animations usage in Hero section JSX
findings.summary: The 5-token animation shorthand order (name duration delay easing fill-mode) is non-obvious in Tailwind v4 arbitrary syntax. Add a code comment explaining token order.
